newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan says 17 tricked into prostitution in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan says 17 tricked into prostitution in Japan.

text.p: Taiwan said on Monday 17 local women were tricked into becoming prostitutes in Japan after accepting offers to work in the Japanese service sector.
Taiwan's foreign ministry said the women were rescued after they contacted Japanese police and Taiwan's unofficial representative office in Tokyo for help.

Some of the women said they had been lured to Japan by promises of jobs as hairdressers, accountants or waitresses, only to be forced into prostitution by their sponsors, possibly a major international crime ring, Taiwan media said.
The ministry said it has instructed Taiwan's de facto embassy in Tokyo office to set up a 24-hour emergency hot line in Japan to handle such cases.
Taiwan has no official presence in Japan because Tokyo has diplomatic ties only with Taipei's arch rival, the Chinese communist government in Beijing.
